svg.desc: End-to-end architecture of N.O.V.A.: offline CCTV indexing (YOLO detection, crops, CLIP embeddings, FAISS index), live investigation pipeline (SearchEngine, InvestigationEngine, ReportGenerator) rendered by the Streamlit console, the Ollama-backed LLM debrief with footage playback, data stores, and the demo/live failsafe modes.
